entries.text: I’m feeling very tired and having little energy . I find it hard to get out of bed . All the stress has been weighing on me lately and it just seems too much to handle . I’m also feeling very lonely , but because of my ankle injury , I can’t go out to meet my friends .

I feel like I’m in a rut , unable to get out . I hear my abusive ex’s voice in my head “you’re too passive . You’re wallowing in self-pity . ” Maybe he’s right . Maybe I don’t have to willpower to continue .

I am feeling ok or neutral this morning . Although my situation is not ideal as I am facing a lot of stress right now , but I can choose to be kind to myself and respond to the life stress with calmness .

I drank too much coffee . I am feeling jittery and anxious . My heart rate is higher than normal . I feel like I’m on edge . Also I’m feeling lonely and down . I wish I could travel with my friends together .

I find it hard to have motivation to do anything . I feel a sense of loss : loss of confidence and identity . I am not sure who I am or what I want anymore . I feel like it’s easier to just sleep all day and not think about anything .

I am moving slowly , feeling listless . I am standing in a crowded , bustling train station , but I am feeling very alone . I feel like no one wants me . I crave connection and love but I have been hurt too many times .

I don’t feel like I did a good job at my job interview today . I feel bad about myself . I have a lot of criticism about myself . I’m trying to challenge my inner critic but I’m still feeling down . I know I need to be more patient with myself and my progress .

I feel overwhelmed . There is so much to do and so little time . I feel the urge to pull away and hide myself from all my responsibilities . But I have to resist the urge , because although it provides temporary relief , it won’t help me in the long run—it will actually make me hate myself more and make my long-term anxiety worse .

My cat is sick , and I am very worried for him . I was in such an anxious state that I missed my job interview so now I feel really bad about myself . I’m having a lot of thoughts of self-blame , and I’m feeling nervous , worried , anxious , and down .

My cat is in pain . I am very worried about him , but I also have a job interview soon and have to prepare for that . The constant stress is making me very tired . I feel like I do not have enough energy to handle the day .
